item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00251","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C06","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 is a clear reusable drafting template. It uses virtually the same two-part structure and distinctive land-office language as the child: discontinuance of one or more district land offices, transfer of their business and necessary archives to a newly established office in another city, and effectiveness at the close of business on a specified date. C06 supplies closely related land-office consolidation machinery but is a somewhat less exact match. C03 shares the numbered-order form and an effective-date clause, but those features alone are routine and do not independently qualify it.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The district land office at Carson City, Nevada, shall be discontinued, and the business and necessary archives of that office shall be transferred to a new district land office which shall be established and maintained at Reno, Nevada.","parent_excerpt":"The district land offices at Blackfoot and Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, shall be discontinued, and the business and necessary archives of those offices shall be transferred to and consolidated in a new district land office which shall be established and maintained at Boise, Idaho.","explanation":"The child closely adapts C04's distinctive operative sentence, changing the offices and locations and omitting consolidation language needed for multiple source offices."},{"child_excerpt":"This order shall become effective at the close of business on August 12, 1949.","parent_excerpt":"This order shall become effective at the close of business on August 13, 1948.","explanation":"Both conclude with the same specific effective-time formula, with only the date changed."}]}
